name: The Presentation of the Blessed Virgin Mary
history: An ancient tradition tells that Joachim and Anne brought Mary as a small child to the Temple in Jerusalem to be offered to God. The feast honours her total dedication to God from the beginning of her life.
meditation: Offer yourself again to God today, as you are.
prayer: O God, by Whose will the blessed Mary, ever Virgin, the dwelling place of the Holy Spirit, was on this day presented in the temple, grant, we beseech You, that by her intercession we may be found worthy to be brought into the temple of Your glory. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen. eiusdem
prayerSource: Collect of the day, Roman Missal of 1962
